subject: Next steps: schedule demo + evaluation kickoff (trial plan & success metrics)
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@acmehealth.com>, Tom Briggs <tbriggs@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: schedule demo + evaluation kickoff (trial plan & success metrics)

Hi Hannah & Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap from our discovery: Acme Health is focused on extracting structured clinical data from intake forms and improving triage accuracy in your referral flow. Primary constraints are (1) sub-500ms latency for short prompts in the triage pipeline, (2) strict PHI controls, and (3) minimizing per-call cost for high throughput.

We suggest two next meetings:
- 60m product demo (overview + UI walkthrough) — helps stakeholders see baseline fit
- 90m technical deep dive + evaluation kickoff — aligns on trial plan, success criteria, prompt set, and infra (VPC/KMS).

Proposed slots (Pacific time):
- Tue Mar 7, 10:00–11:30am PT (demo + short Q&A, 60m)
- Wed Mar 8, 9:00–10:30am PT (technical deep dive + kickoff, 90m)
- Thu Mar 9, 1:00–2:30pm PT (if you need an afternoon option)

If none of those work, send a couple windows that suit your team and we’ll adapt. For the deep dive / kickoff we typically ask for: engineering lead, security/compliance point (for SOC/KMS discussion), and one product owner to confirm success metrics.

Attached: trial-charter-template.pdf (draft we can customize) and security-reqs.xlsx (common items we discuss during kickoffs).

Initial success metric suggestions (for discussion):
- Extraction F1 >= 0.88 on benchmark prompt set
- Median latency <= 500ms for 64-token generation under baseline load
- Throughput target: 50 qps sustained on dedicated capacity or equivalent autoscaled hosted config

Next steps once we lock a slot: (1) we’ll send a calendar invite with owners, (2) we’ll share a short prompt pack to seed the eval, and (3) Marissa (CS) will prepare onboarding materials for the trial environment.

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 12:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: schedule demo + evaluation kickoff (trial plan & success metrics)

Thanks Avery — appreciate the clear recap. Tom and I reviewed the proposed windows and the Wed Mar 8 9:00–10:30am PT slot looks best for the technical deep dive + kickoff. The broader product demo is useful, but we’d prefer to fold a short 20–30m demo into the first 30m of the deep dive so we keep stakeholder time down.

A few clarifying questions before the kickoff:
- Can you share an example prompt set (a few sample intake records + expected structured outputs) so our clinical SME can validate upfront?
- For PHI handling, will the private deployment option (VPC + customer-managed KMS) be available during the trial or only for production?
- On success metrics: we may want to prioritize precision over recall for certain fields; is your eval framework flexible to weight metrics by field?

I’ll tentatively accept the Mar 8 slot — please send an invite and include Rishi if he’ll be part of the tech discussion.

Best,
Hannah Lee
Director of Clinical Operations
Acme Health
hannah.lee@acmehealth.com
